amendments.after: the test compile outputs were seen; before any closed-loop episode
amendments.text: Zone-level regions. UpCloud components are written 'ZONE: Product' (e.g. 'DE-FRA1: Network Connections'); the product is not a place, and the candidate list mixed 69 zone-product pairs so that a correct zone answer could not be resolved to one entry (7B answered 'US-SJO1', 72B copied the full pair). Items now take the zone as the region (candidates 69 -> 20; two notices become single-region and are excluded from the closed loop and the comparison because they have no compile outputs); the answer resolver maps a 'ZONE: Product' answer to its zone for every arm. Stored model outputs are re-scored (0 calls); pre-amendment items kept as runs/affected_scenario_20261013/items_before_amendment1.json; both scorings reported. Pinned sources updated.
